macro.name: Cloak of Displacement

description.value:
Wondrous Item, Rare (Requires Attunement)

While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while your Speed is 0.

Foundry Note

The cloak creates a "Displaced" effect that grants disadvantage on all attacks against the wearer. When the wearer takes damage, the Displaced effect is removed (via isDamaged special duration). At the start of each turn, the macro re-creates it if missing. If all movement speeds are 0, the effect is not created (and removed if present).
